answer: Gate every bid behind a live human challenge ticket. One: at bid time the registry issues a fresh image puzzle seeded by the epoch, due within ninety seconds. Two: the solved ticket is single-use, signed to the bidding key, and dies with the epoch, so none can be reused or resold. Three: three failed solves lock the identity until the next epoch. A thousand-clone farm needs a thousand human solves per epoch, about $1,000 a day at a dollar a solve, while one honest agent pays nothing but a minute. Like a comet, a real pulse of human effort leaves a trail no yarrow field of fakes can copy.
